text: たまに　ピクッと　うごいてる！

structure.jp: ピクッと　うごいてる！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている, which says something is happening now or keeps happening. うごいてる = 'is moving'.

patterns.name: 〜と (how)
patterns.explanation: と after a sound-effect word shows the way the action happens. ピクッと = 'with a twitch'.
